comparison.objective: Reinsert a returned box into a size-ordered shelf row; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Box handoff, shifting, placement and row closure versus fine hex-tool engagement, collar adjustment and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct size order against shelf stops versus two safe, repeatable axial damping cycles within travel, force and rebound limits.
comparison.reason: The shelf task tests bimanual object organization, not adjustment and empirical validation of a dynamic damping mechanism.
